intent: I have Dad’s coat and the spare service-truck keys in my hands, and I am already calculating the fastest route to the relay. The north bridge may still be open, but every report from the road is worse than the last. I am angry that strangers are receiving the final minutes that belong to us. Someone else can inherit the broken tower. I need Dad to choose the one promise only he can keep.
emotion: frightened, angry, and pleading through direct technical language
